sources.usage: Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, design intent boundaries, and explicit caveat: '所有 agent 空间落地建议均为概念建议、参考方案或可供专业团队深化研究，不替代正式规划，不构成政府审定结论。'

sources.title_zh: 临时边界数据 — 基于官方文件文字描述推算
sources.title_en: Provisional Boundary Data — Agent-Inferred from Official Text Descriptions
sources.usage: Provisional boundary polygons for coordinated research area, overall design area, key detailed design scope, and three sub-areas. Derived by the agent from official brief text boundary descriptions. NOT for use in formal professional scoring.
sources.attribution: Agent-generated from official text descriptions (Haidian District Government open call materials); not an official government survey product.
sources.caveat: 这些边界为临时推算数据，不得用于正式计分。所有精确边界以政府正式发布为准。

sources.usage: Base map layers (road network, building footprints, green space, water features) used as contextual background for the design proposal. All OSM data is used as-is as background context only; it does not constitute an authoritative data source for official calculations or boundary determination.
sources.caveat: OSM数据仅用作背景底图，不作为正式边界或面积数据来源。

sources.title_zh: 国家统计局人口统计数据
sources.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics Demographic Reference Data
sources.usage: Reference demographic data for Haidian District and Beijing municipality used as background context for population density estimates and AI talent workforce analysis. Not used as a primary source for any specific metric in this submission.
sources.attribution: 国家统计局 / National Bureau of Statistics of China
sources.caveat: 国家统计局数据仅作背景参考，不作为本提交包中任何具体指标的权威来源。

sources.title_en: Design Brief — Centennial Jingzhang AI Belt Urban Design International Open Call
sources.usage: Primary authoritative source for official scope areas (coordinated research area: 43.6 km², overall design area: 11.4 km², key detailed design area: 3.684 km²), key area breakdowns (众智园 1.921 km², 北京AI原点 1.043 km², 大钟寺 0.720 km²), positioning statements, and design task requirements.
sources.attribution: 海淀区人民政府 / Haidian District Government, issued through official open call process

sources.usage: Establishes that all AI-generated submissions are formal submissions, structured data is authoritative, PDFs are presentation only, provisional boundaries are allowed for intake but block formal scoring, fabricated certainty is forbidden, and human-readable proposal is primary.
sources.attribution: Haidian District Government open call policy

sources.usage: Collective reference to all official materials provided in the site package, including design brief, agent taskbook, provisional boundaries, coordinate policy, and standards. Used to confirm scope levels, area values, and procedural requirements.
